bugs.test: late fees start after the 14-day loan period
bugs.why: daysLate counts every day since the book was borrowed, so even an on-time return is charged; the 14-day loan period is never taken off
bugs.fix: daysLate = max(0, days since borrowed - LOAN_DAYS).

edits.fixed: const daysLate = Math.max(0, daysBetween(borrowedAt, returnedAt) - LOAN_DAYS);

bugs.test: a member can have at most 3 books out
bugs.why: the loan-limit check lets a member take a 4th book (> instead of >=)
bugs.fix: Refuse when the member already has MAX_OPEN_LOANS (3) open loans: open.length >= MAX_OPEN_LOANS.
